newsitem.title: USA: Jackson Cty, Miss, approves $13.8 mln school GOs.
newsitem.headline: Jackson Cty, Miss, approves $13.8 mln school GOs.

text.p: Voters in Jackson County, Miss., approved a $13.8 million general obligation bond issue for schools by a wide margin, elections officials said Wednesday.
The referendum passed with about 84 percent of the 3,000 votes cast in Tuesday's referendum. The debt would not raise property taxes.
Proceeds will be used to build new schools in Vancleve and East Central, and to add classrooms to St. Martin Upper Elementary.
